rating_reasons.gameplay: Recovering three memories creates a clear loop, and optic shots reward precision. Stronger second-run aim produced two critical kills. Movement repeatedly stopped at cover and the boss was difficult to acquire before incoming patrol fire killed me. Neither run reached upload, so later pacing remains unassessed.
rating_reasons.presentation: Cohesive rain, teal and amber palette, reflective wet floor, typography and striking Heart sculpture give the station an identity. Repeated simple rectangular architecture, mannequin-like small robots and sparse scene dressing keep this visibly below AAA finish.
rating_reasons.usability: Persistent controls, map, objective distances, recovery ring feedback and retry button help. Clear MOVE CLOSER feedback appeared at 3.2m, but I spent several exposed holds just outside range before success. Cover navigation and boss clear sightline were persistent obstacles.
rating_reasons.readability: Large health/ammo and memory cards are readable. Small minimap geometry, tiny spaced captions and directional threat brackets were harder to interpret. Custodian percentages/window messaging were clear, but component sightlines were occluded by walls and pillars.
rating_reasons.overall_AAA_readiness: A coherent playable slice with effective art direction and recoverable objectives, but these two losses, awkward cover routing, limited combat variety observed and simple enemy/environment detail do not support AAA-ready status.

attempts.boss: Activated after third recovery. Last visible coil values 100%, 100%, 100%; no confirmed boss damage or coil disable.
actions_and_observations: Aimed slightly above initial crosshair with look y=-15; 13 rifle rounds produced WARDEN CRITICAL +180 and one elimination.
Opened M facility map and used west archive/Heart/east archive layout. Held Tab once: visible ground arrows, while movement remained held during capture.
W+A approach stopped against low cover at 42m; W plus Space did not visibly clear it. Strafed farther west to pass. No confirmed vault.
Held E after stepping left near west terminal; Mara recovered and reserve supplies increased.
Heart route overshot to north wall; repeated E holds at 9m/10m/5.3m did not recover. Backed up and strafed right, then Sera memory card confirmed recovery.
Moved diagonally southeast; east recovery required an additional right strafe. Elian recovered and all three objective boxes filled.
Large look turns and arrows were difficult to judge; arrows changed position without clear turn. Later look with a wait yielded controlled heading changes.
Late rifle bursts aimed at architecture/pillars while trying to get a coil sightline; all coils remained 100%. Shift produced recharge on one push, but end screen reported zero phase evades.
Recovered some shield while behind cover; reached boss vicinity at low health and died under incoming fire.

attempts.boss: Activated. All coils last observed at 100%. Saw three numbered shutters from side opening. Final burst attempted at visible assembly, but death prevented confirming damage.
actions_and_observations: Clicked DEPLOY AGAIN. Initial upward optic shot used 8 rounds and killed guard.
West approach again ran into cover, so shifted farther west before advancing. Repeated E holds outside ring failed; left strafe brought terminal into recovery range.
Tried aiming at west patrol; burst did not add an elimination.
Moved east and north to Heart; a small upward correction and rifle burst killed Heart warden, second elimination confirmed.
At Heart 3.2m, visible MOVE CLOSER / STEP INSIDE THE FLOOR RING appeared; a short W move and held E recovered Sera.

Reloaded and moved southeast; east approach required incremental right strafes. At 3.2m visible ring teaching repeated; next short strafe and E recovered Elian. Health had dropped to 57 then replenished to 64 after recovery.
Backed south and turned to boss side; incoming fire reduced health to 28.
Strafed around side wall, used Shift and saw recharge, then end screen reported 1 phase evade. This supports an evade occurred, not a specific observed charge break.
Saw three numbered coil shutters, turned rifle toward assembly and fired; terminal loss followed. No confirmed coil disable.

controls_teaching_noticed_and_used: WASD movement, mouse look, left fire, R reload, E hold recover, M paused map, Tab held trace, Space vault/jump attempted, Shift phase dash attempted, Escape automatic pause.
Induction guard banner explicitly taught Shift, optic aim or flanking. Heart banner taught break warden or precise optic fire.
Visible C crouch by low cover / lower profile teaching noticed, but C not used; no crouch claim. Ctrl sprint, RMB aim and 1/2 weapon keys were shown but not used.
Custodian messaging taught three coils, shutter armor chip/wait, open window, move to cover/Shift close to break, and wall sign SHUTTERS LIFT / FIRE.
limitations: Paused synthetic browser-input play through existing driver; screenshots and scheduling add delays. This is not continuous human mouse play.

Some large look commands changed screenshot heading after metadata snapshot; I relied on screenshots and small follow-up batches. Arrows were not a reliable substitute for mouse turning in this session.
Software-WebGL fallback was reported at launch. Renderer flags do not certify hardware acceleration or AAA performance.
No audio assessment, source inspection, hidden state, game evaluation/hooks, tests/builds, external reviews or additional browsers used.
No confirmed crouch, sprint, vault, ADS, weapon-switch effectiveness, boss disable or upload completion.
